description: This file contains test cases and validation functions for the 'utf8' library in Lua, including tests for string length, codepoint extraction, offset calculations, error handling, and handling of surrogate pairs and Unicode code points.

methods.name: len
methods.description: Calculate the length of a string by counting codepoints, ignoring continuation bytes

methods.name: checksyntax
methods.description: Verify that a string matches a list of codepoints by constructing a string with Unicode escape sequences and evaluating it

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs multiple validations on a string 's' and its codepoint list 't', including length, codepoint conversion, offsets, syntax, and iteration correctness
